required.ue4_root: root of an Unreal Engine 4.26 install used to build/cook CARLA 0.9.16
required.carla_source: CARLA 0.9.16 source checkout (the 0.9.16-compatible fork/branch), not the packaged binary

why_cook_is_impossible_with_what_is_inst.consequence: A packaged Shipping build cannot run UnrealEditor-Cmd, cannot run `make import`, and cannot cook content. CARLA import/cook of the promoted Ingolstadt package therefore cannot execute on this machine.

blocked_consequences: step 8 revalidate-staged-package CAN still be done offline (XODR SHA + tile SHA manifest + descriptor) -- not a UE dependency
step 9 UE4_IMPORT_COOK_RECEIPT / COOKED_MAP_AUTHORITY: CANNOT BE PRODUCED
step 12 RUNTIME_MAP_IDENTITY_AUTO: CANNOT BE PRODUCED (Ingolstadt auto map is not in client.get_available_maps(); it only exists after import/cook)
step 13 LIVE_CALIBRATION_ACCEPTANCE on the auto arm: CANNOT BE PRODUCED
step 14 RQ3 paired capture (manual+auto): CANNOT BE PRODUCED -- requires BOTH arms
step 15 RQ5(a) mIoU on generated + manual held-out: CANNOT BE PRODUCED (depends on 14)
step 16 RQ5(b): DEFERRED_EXTERNAL_DATA (no operator-supplied external dataset present)

manual_arm_runtime_is_live.note: Independent of the cook blocker, the manual reference arm IS available at runtime (Grid0828 cooked in the CARLA 0.9.16 install).

required_operator_actions_to_unblock: 1) git clone --branch 0.9.16 https://github.com/carla-simulator/carla (or the project-approved 0.9.16-compatible fork) to E:\carla_src
2) Install Epic Games Launcher + Unreal Engine 4.26.4, then set UE4_ROOT to that install
3) Install Visual Studio 2019 (v142 toolset, Desktop C++ workload) so Setup.bat / GenerateProjectFiles can run
4) From the CARLA source root on a Developer PowerShell: .\Setup.bat  then  .\Build.bat -Editor Win64
5) Re-run this wave; step 9 will then execute make import + UnrealEditor-Cmd cook of the promoted Import/Ingolstadt package
notes: Per instruction, UE5 was NOT substituted and arbitrary stock UE4 was NOT used. No offline validator was weakened to work around this blocker.
